title: AI shouldn’t trade for you. It should make you a better trader.
author: Aayush_Gohil
selftext:
Been trading for years and always hated juggling four different tools just to make one decision. So I started building While25 — an agentic terminal that brings it all together.

AI assistant, market watch, and backtesting are live right now. More data rolling in every week.

It’s early and rough around the edges. Would love brutally honest feedback from people who actually trade.

http://terminal.while25.com

replies.author: Aayush_Gohil
replies.body:
Thank you! I would love to hear brutal feedback. If you have time I can also go over it on a demo.

But this means a lot, thanks!
